name: notification
description: Show a native OS notification to the user.

manual.overview: Use desktop notifications when the user is at their machine and you need quick, non-intrusive alerts. Ideal for completion signals, reminders, or background task results without leaving the current context.

examples.description: Notify when a long task completes

tips: Keep body short; desktop notifications are small; long text gets truncated
Use title for context (e.g. Alert, Done, Error) so the user can prioritize at a glance
Best for non-critical alerts; do not rely on it for must-acknowledge messages
Works without network; useful when other channels are unavailable
edge_cases: User may have Do Not Disturb or notification permissions disabled; the notification may not appear
Some OSes limit notification length or frequency; very long or rapid-fire notifications may be dropped
macOS may require notification permissions to be granted in System Preferences first
